items.title: QUEST
items.desc: Escape rooms, VR, challenges, and adrenaline-filled activities for anyone who'd rather move, solve, and compete than sit still.

items.title: CUISINE
items.desc: Group dinners, halal restaurant crawls, food adventures, and the occasional cooking night for anyone who plans their week around food.

items.title: ARTS
items.desc: Painting nights, DIY sessions, creative workshops, and low-key crafternoons — no talent required, just a willingness to make something.

items.title: FIELD
items.desc: Lakes, hikes, cabins, nature days, and the occasional getaways for when the group chat needs to actually leave the city.

items.title: QURAN
items.desc: Recite, review and reflect together — a consistent circle for staying close to the Quran.

items.title: BADMINTON
items.desc: Casual badminton plans, drop-ins, and games for girls who want to play, improve, and actually find people to play with.

items.title: COWORK
items.desc: Casual co-working sessions for getting out of the house, getting things done, and having company while you work or study.

items.title: STEPS
items.desc: Casual walks, step challenges, and meetups for anyone who wants a reason to compete in steps count.
